name: EPOS 11
detailed_description:
EPOS 11 is a first-person, story-driven sci-fi horror game set on a partially evacuated space station deep in orbit. As the player arrives aboard the crumbling EPOS 11 station, they must complete a series of assigned tasks while unraveling the dark secrets of what happened there.

The gameplay focuses on atmosphere, exploration, and environmental storytelling. Players move through abandoned corridors, interact with terminals, collect clues, and piece together the station’s mysterious downfall. Tension builds gradually through visual and audio cues—no sudden jump scares, but a persistent sense of dread.

The game features:

  • First-person immersive gameplay

  • A branching storyline with multiple outcomes based on player decisions

  • No combat, but heavy focus on narrative tension, discovery, and immersion

  • Environmental puzzles and task-based progression

  • Dynamic visual effects

  • A minimalist, eerie soundtrack enhancing the sense of isolation

Playtime is approximately 1.5–2.5 hours, depending on exploration. The game is ideal for fans of sci-fi thrillers, narrative-heavy experiences, and slow-burn psychological horror.

There are no graphic depictions of violence, but scenes include blood, psychological distress, and disturbing environments.

short_description: You arrive at the EPOS 11 space station during an evacuation, where tasks and dark secrets await. A story-driven sci-fi horror experience where exploration, oppressive atmosphere, and the choices you make shape the unfolding narrative

content_descriptors.notes: The game features scenes of violence, including lethal attacks against humans or creatures, as well as visual depictions of blood and injury. The story conveys a dark, oppressive atmosphere, occasionally involving intense psychological tension. There is no graphic torture or excessive gore, but some moments may be disturbing or emotionally intense.
